description: Hand-maintained annotations for the generated HTTP reference. The generator fails when a path-shaped literal in the API definition sources has no entry here, or when an entry matches no literal in the corpus, so this file cannot rot.

routes.description_en: Mint a channel-bound local bearer (management or task) from the bootstrap secret proof.
routes.description_zh: 凭 bootstrap secret 证明铸造通道绑定的本地 bearer（management 或 task）。

routes.description_en: Unauthenticated bounded liveness probe; deliberately not a readiness claim.
routes.description_zh: 免认证的有界存活探测；有意不构成 readiness 声明。

routes.description_en: Component status projection (system, database, secret, provider, daemon, pi); Provider facts and SecretStore resolution use one loaded config snapshot.
routes.description_zh: 组件状态投影（system、database、secret、provider、daemon、pi）；Provider 事实与 SecretStore 解析使用同一份已加载配置快照。

routes.description_en: Alias of the snapshot-consistent status projection.
routes.description_zh: 快照一致 status 投影的别名。

routes.description_en: Redacted snapshot-consistent diagnostic projection including six-resource, headless-vault, and operability sections.
routes.description_zh: 快照一致的脱敏诊断投影，含六资源、headless vault 与可运维性小节。

routes.description_en: Daemon-owned Provider proxy; non-streaming, selected-model-bound; secrets resolved server-side only. Success responses always carry `X-CognitiveOS-Provider-Network-Nanos`. When `COGNITIVEOS_PI_ROUTE_OBSERVATION=enabled` and the request carries one well-formed opaque `campaign-<32 lowercase hex>` correlation id, the daemon also echoes that id and reports `X-CognitiveOS-Daemon-Preflight-Nanos` (config/selected-model/SecretStore work, disjoint from the network exchange). Malformed or duplicate correlation headers are ignored; the product body is unchanged and nothing is persisted.
routes.description_zh: daemon 持有的 Provider 代理；非流式、绑定 selected model；secret 仅在服务端解析。成功响应始终携带 `X-CognitiveOS-Provider-Network-Nanos`。当 `COGNITIVEOS_PI_ROUTE_OBSERVATION=enabled` 且请求携带一条形态正确的不透明 `campaign-<32 位小写 hex>` correlation id 时，daemon 还会回显该 id 并报告 `X-CognitiveOS-Daemon-Preflight-Nanos`（配置/selected-model/SecretStore，与网络交换互不重叠）。畸形或重复的 correlation 头被忽略；产品 body 不变，且绝不持久化。

routes.description_en: Non-secret selected-model projection.
routes.description_zh: 非 secret 的 selected-model 投影。

routes.description_en: Private versioned six-family resource projection (family + version query).
routes.description_zh: 私有版本化六资源族投影（family + version 查询参数）。

routes.description_en: Family-scoped resource watch with optional resume_from cursor.
routes.description_zh: 按资源族的 watch，支持可选 resume_from 游标。

routes.description_en: Append a Context authorization fact set.
routes.description_zh: 追加 Context 授权事实集。

routes.description_en: Append a Context revocation fact (advances tenant revocation epoch).
routes.description_zh: 追加 Context 撤销事实（推进租户撤销 epoch）。

routes.description_en: Load one immutable Memory object by id.
routes.description_zh: 按 id 读取一个不可变 Memory 对象。

routes.description_en: Explain one Skill binding (package, revision, revocation state).
routes.description_zh: 解释一个 Skill binding（package、revision、撤销状态）。

routes.description_en: Explicit remember: creates a Memory candidate and runs deterministic admission.
routes.description_zh: 显式 remember：创建 Memory candidate 并执行确定性 admission。

routes.description_en: Forget an admitted Memory object via a durable tombstone.
routes.description_zh: 通过持久 tombstone 遗忘已接纳的 Memory 对象。

routes.description_en: Import an immutable local Skill package/revision.
routes.description_zh: 导入不可变的本地 Skill package/revision。

routes.description_en: Bind a compatible Skill revision to a scope target.
routes.description_zh: 将兼容的 Skill revision 绑定到目标 scope。

routes.description_en: Append an immutable Skill binding revocation.
routes.description_zh: 追加不可变的 Skill binding 撤销记录。

routes.description_en: Durably record raw user intent before any interpretation.
routes.description_zh: 在任何解释之前持久记录原始用户意图。

routes.description_en: Persist a probabilistic interpretation candidate; material ambiguity forces clarification_required.
routes.description_zh: 持久化概率性解释候选；实质歧义强制 clarification_required。

routes.description_en: Server-issued digest-bound contract preview; persists nothing.
routes.description_zh: 服务端签发的 digest 绑定合同预览；不持久化。

routes.description_en: Admit the exact preview digest and mint the TaskContract under epoch CAS.
routes.description_zh: 接纳精确 preview digest 并在 epoch CAS 下铸造 TaskContract。

routes.description_en: Reconstruct bounded redacted lifecycle, Effect reconciliation, verification, acceptance, and durable cursor evidence for one task_ref from authority and Artifact CAS.
routes.description_zh: 从 authority 与 Artifact CAS 为一个 task_ref 重建有界脱敏的生命周期、Effect 对账、verification、acceptance 与持久游标证据。

routes.description_en: Return bounded Effect history for one task_ref: opaque original-key digest, stage, outcome/reconcile class, mutation count 0/1 or absent when indeterminate, and report refs. Receipts, raw parameters, and extra query fields are refused.
routes.description_zh: 返回一个 task_ref 的有界 Effect 历史：不透明 original-key digest、stage、outcome/reconcile class、mutation count 仅 0/1 或在不确定时缺省，以及 report refs。拒绝 receipt、原始参数和额外查询字段。

routes.description_en: Return bounded O2/O3/O4/O5/O13 observation for one task_ref. Empty collectors return observed_zero with a named negative control; prompt/body/receipt/capability query keys fail closed. O5 reuses redacted Effect history; O13 is durable audit cursor/replay with stale-cursor, digest-break, and gap negatives. Not a second authority API.
routes.description_zh: 返回一个 task_ref 的有界 O2/O3/O4/O5/O13 观测。空 collector 返回带具名 negative control 的 observed_zero；prompt/body/receipt/capability 查询键失败闭合。O5 复用脱敏 Effect 历史；O13 是持久审计游标回放，含过期游标、digest 断裂与缺口负例。不是第二套 authority API。

routes.description_en: Alias of GET /task/observation on the task resource prefix.
routes.description_zh: task 资源前缀上 GET /task/observation 的别名。

routes.description_en: Rejected: observation samples are daemon-authored; callers cannot write the plane.
routes.description_zh: 拒绝：观测样本由 daemon 写入；调用方不能写该平面。

routes.description_en: Forbidden: observation is a task-channel read plane, not a management authority API.
routes.description_zh: 禁止：观测是 task 通道只读平面，不是 management authority API。

routes.description_en: Forbidden: observation is a task-channel read plane, not a management authority API.
routes.description_zh: 禁止：观测是 task 通道只读平面，不是 management authority API。

routes.description_en: Read the default-off task-scoped authorized fault profile. Missing records mean faults stay off. Ordinary task callers are denied.
routes.description_zh: 读取默认关闭的 task 范围授权 fault profile。缺失记录表示故障注入保持关闭。普通 task 调用方被拒绝。

routes.description_en: Persist a default-off or campaign-authorized fixed fault profile for one task_ref. Unauthorized campaigns and task-channel callers fail closed. No raw parameter or receipt is stored.
routes.description_zh: 为一个 task_ref 持久化默认关闭或评测授权的固定 fault profile。未授权 campaign 与 task 通道调用方失败闭合。不存储原始参数或 receipt。

routes.description_en: Read the task/campaign-scoped pinned HTTPS origin allowlist. Missing records leave production HttpFetchReadOnly empty (fail closed). Ordinary task callers are denied.
routes.description_zh: 读取 task/campaign 范围的钉住 HTTPS origin 白名单。缺失记录表示生产 HttpFetchReadOnly 白名单保持为空（失败闭合）。普通 task 调用方被拒绝。

routes.description_en: Pin exact HTTPS origins (host or host:port) for one task_ref under an authorized campaign. GET/HEAD only; no credentials, redirects, inherited proxy, or request body. Unauthorized campaigns and task-channel callers fail closed.
routes.description_zh: 在授权 campaign 下为一个 task_ref 钉住精确 HTTPS origin（host 或 host:port）。仅 GET/HEAD；无凭据、不跟随重定向、不继承代理、无请求体。未授权 campaign 与 task 通道调用方失败闭合。

routes.description_en: Project registered native Tools with overlay lifecycle, execution_readiness, and whether each is currently Agent-exposed. Overlay state never enters the immutable descriptor digest.
routes.description_zh: 投影已登记原生 Tool 的 overlay lifecycle、execution_readiness，以及当前是否对 Agent 暴露。overlay 状态永不进入不可变 descriptor digest。

routes.description_en: Alias of the registered Tool lifecycle projection; stops the previous generic-authority fall-through on tool/discover.
routes.description_zh: 已登记 Tool lifecycle 投影的别名；阻止先前 tool/discover 落入通用 authority 处理器。

routes.description_en: Enable one registered operation_id. Quarantined and revoked Tools fail closed. Task-channel callers are denied.
routes.description_zh: 启用一个已登记 operation_id。被隔离或撤销的 Tool 失败闭合。task 通道调用方被拒绝。

routes.description_en: Disable one registered operation_id. Agent exposure updates atomically with the overlay.
routes.description_zh: 禁用一个已登记 operation_id。Agent 暴露随 overlay 原子更新。

routes.description_en: Quarantine one registered operation_id. Enable remains blocked until a later non-quarantine overlay is out of scope for this surface.
routes.description_zh: 隔离一个已登记 operation_id。在本表面内 enable 保持阻断。

routes.description_en: Revoke one registered operation_id. Revocation is terminal for this overlay.
routes.description_zh: 撤销一个已登记 operation_id。对本 overlay 而言撤销是终态。

routes.description_en: Read the current least Agent exposure set and digest for one task_ref.
routes.description_zh: 读取一个 task_ref 当前最窄 Agent 暴露集合及其 digest。

routes.description_en: Task-channel read of the same registered Tool lifecycle projection.
routes.description_zh: task 通道读取同一份已登记 Tool lifecycle 投影。

routes.description_en: Return the least Agent-exposed Tool set and exposure_digest for one task_ref. Extra prompt/body/receipt query keys fail closed.
routes.description_zh: 返回一个 task_ref 的最窄 Agent 暴露集合与 exposure_digest。额外的 prompt/body/receipt 查询键失败闭合。

routes.description_en: Record a bounded Tool selection receipt: candidate_set_digest must equal the current exposure digest, the selected operation_id must be exposed, and prompt/body/receipt restatement is refused.
routes.description_zh: 记录有界 Tool 选择收据：candidate_set_digest 必须等于当前暴露 digest，所选 operation_id 必须已被暴露，且拒绝 prompt/body/receipt 重述。

routes.description_en: Snapshot-first bounded Task watch with optional resume_from.
routes.description_zh: 快照优先的有界 Task watch，支持可选 resume_from。

routes.description_en: Task-bound Memory/Skill resource projection (requires task_ref); served through the `/task/resource/` prefix rewrite onto the shared resource handler.
routes.description_zh: Task 绑定的 Memory/Skill 资源投影（需要 task_ref）；经 `/task/resource/` 前缀重写复用共享 resource 处理器。

routes.description_en: Task-bound resource watch, served through the same prefix rewrite.
routes.description_zh: Task 绑定的资源 watch，经同一前缀重写提供。

routes.description_en: Return the latest daemon-authored redacted Memory/Skill consumption pins for one task_ref; query_text and skill_binding_id are rejected as restatement; forgotten, revoked, or digest-drifted records fail closed without pins.
routes.description_zh: 返回一个 task_ref 上最新的 daemon 写入脱敏 Memory/Skill 消费钉；query_text 与 skill_binding_id 视为重述并拒绝；遗忘、撤销或 digest 漂移的记录在返回钉之前失败闭合。

routes.description_en: Record a Task-trace Memory/Skill consumption bound to current authority facts.
routes.description_zh: 记录绑定当前权威事实的 Task trace Memory/Skill 消费。

routes.description_en: Write a secret-excluding Personal backup archive. Never copies authority SQLite, bootstrap secrets, bearer material, or provider-config.
routes.description_zh: 写入排除 secret 的 Personal 备份归档。永不复制 authority SQLite、bootstrap secret、bearer 或 provider-config。

routes.description_en: Verify one archive_id (schema, part digests, completeness, secret/SQLite exclusion) without mutating live layout.
routes.description_zh: 校验一个 archive_id（schema、分片 digest、完整性、secret/SQLite 排除）且不改写 live layout。

routes.description_en: Preflight then transactionally restore one archive_id. Failure rolls live trees back; secrets and SQLite stay uncopied.
routes.description_zh: 预检后事务恢复一个 archive_id。失败则回滚 live 树；secret 与 SQLite 仍不被复制。

routes.description_en: Forbidden: backup/restore are management-channel only.
routes.description_zh: 禁止：backup/restore 仅限 management 通道。

routes.description_en: Forbidden: backup/restore are management-channel only.
routes.description_zh: 禁止：backup/restore 仅限 management 通道。

routes.description_en: Forbidden alias of the management backup writer.
routes.description_zh: 禁止：management 备份写入器的 task 别名。

routes.description_en: Forbidden alias of the management restore writer.
routes.description_zh: 禁止：management 恢复写入器的 task 别名。

routes.description_en: One-shot private Unix-socket completion used by the daemon-launched Pi candidate process; Authorization headers are forbidden.
routes.description_zh: daemon 启动的 Pi candidate 进程使用的一次性私有 Unix socket completion；禁止 Authorization 头。
